game_title: Range Check Bridge – Lighthouse Point Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the harbor master must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about bridge_load to power up the harbor master and open the harbor gate.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Lighthouse Point'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Lighthouse Point.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
